claims.claim: Direct tokunbo, highest grade, from Japan
claims.evidence: No nameplate, origin sticker, or import stamp legible in either photo.
Contradicts the same seller's prior statement of Japan origin; both cannot be true, and no shipping/import marks are visible to resolve it.
No part number, casting number, or model code is legible on the casing in Photo 0 or 1.
Photos show a static disassembled unit on the ground; no test bench, dipstick check, or running clip is shown.
No odometer, donor-vehicle history, or usage tag visible; mileage of a used transmission cannot be read from external casing photos.
Case seam, torque converter seating, and bolt torque marks are not shown clearly enough to confirm the unit hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Internal condition (gears, clutch packs, torque converter) is completely unknown
risks.proof: Video of the unit being bench-tested or spun up, or teardown photos showing clutch pack and converter condition
risks.if_unproven: price as untested/unknown internal condition, worst case

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific Rogue/Altima engine or trim cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part/casting number tag or VIN of donor vehicle

risks.risk: Completeness of the assembly (sensors, mounts, torque converter) is unclear
risks.proof: Full photo of all included parts laid out together

risks.risk: Fluid condition, leaks, or stored fault codes unknown
risks.proof: Video showing fluid level/color check or a scan tool reading if bench-tested
risks.if_unproven: price as leaking/faulty until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Conflicting origin claims (Japan vs Belgium) suggest a copied/misleading listing
risks.proof: Import paperwork, bill of lading, or customs documentation matching the claimed origin
risks.if_unproven: treat origin and all seller claims as unverified, priced at worst case

proof_requests: Photo of the part/casting number or VIN tag on the transmission case
Video of the transmission being tested or spun on a bench
Full-unit photo showing torque converter, sensors, and mounts together
Clear photo of the partially visible label from Photo 1
Any import/customs documentation matching the claimed country of origin
response.reason: The seller's own account contradicts itself on country of origin (Japan vs Belgium), a classic sign of a copy-pasted or misleading listing, and none of the critical fitment, condition, or testing claims can be verified from the photos.
